[September 2026]{.news-date}

### MELANOBS presented at the 11th Pacific Islands Conference on Nature Conservation

Thomas Ibanez presented the MELANOBS project during a Species Working Group session of the 11th Pacific Islands Conference on Nature Conservation and Protected Areas, held at the Tjibaou Cultural Centre in Nouméa, New Caledonia (7–11 September 2026).
:::
:::

::: {.news-item}
![](images/home-banner.jpg){fig-alt="Aerial view of a dense green forest canopy."}

::: {.news-text}
[July 2026]{.news-date}

### New permanent plot at Vago, Fiji

A team from UMR AMAP in New Caledonia, together with the Fiji Ministry of Forestry and the University of the South Pacific, set up a new 1-ha permanent forest plot at Vago, on the island of Viti Levu, Fiji. See the [Vago plot page](plots/vago.qmd).
:::
:::

::: {.news-item}
![](images/siloam-2025.jpg){fig-alt="Two people in the forest looking up at a tall tree trunk, one holding a clipboard."}

::: {.news-text}
[December 2025]{.news-date}

### New permanent plot at Siloam, New Caledonia

A team from UMR AMAP in New Caledonia, together with the Environment Department of the Loyalty Islands Province and with the great help of the local community, set up a new 1-ha permanent forest plot at Siloam, on the island of Lifou, New Caledonia. See the [Siloam plot page](plots/siloam.qmd).
:::
:::

::: {.news-item}
![](images/poitete-2025.jpg){fig-alt="Team members at the base of a large buttressed tree, one on a ladder measuring the trunk."}

::: {.news-text}
[May 2025]{.news-date}

### New permanent plot at Poitete, Solomon Islands

A team from UMR AMAP in New Caledonia, together with Solomon Islands National University and the Solomon Islands Ministry of Forestry and Research, set up a new 1-ha permanent forest plot at Poitete, on the island of Kolombangara, Solomon Islands. See the [Poitete plot page](plots/poitete.qmd).
:::
:::

::: {.news-item}
![](images/blue-river-2025.jpg){fig-alt="A person on a ladder measuring the trunk of a large tree in a forest with palms."}

::: {.news-text}
[March 2025]{.news-date}

### New permanent plot at Blue River, New Caledonia

A team from UMR AMAP in New Caledonia set up the first 1-ha MELANOBS permanent forest plot in New Caledonia, at Blue River, in the Blue River Provincial Park on the island of Grande Terre. See the [Blue River plot page](plots/blue-river.qmd).
:::
:::

::: {.news-item}
![](images/nusumetu-2024.jpg){fig-alt="Two people measuring the trunk of a large buttressed tree with a tape, one standing on a stepladder."}

::: {.news-text}
[November 2024]{.news-date}

### First permanent plot at Nusumetu, Vanuatu

A team from UMR AMAP in New Caledonia, together with the Vanuatu Department of Forestry and with the great help of the Nusumetu community, set up the project's first 1-ha permanent forest plot at Nusumetu, on the island of Tanna, Vanuatu. See the [Nusumetu plot page](plots/nusumetu.qmd).
:::
:::

::: {.news-item}
![](images/workshop-2024-noumea.jpg){fig-alt="MELANOBS partners working on laptops around a meeting table, with the workshop title slide on a screen."}

::: {.news-text}
[April 2024]{.news-date}

### Kick-off workshop in New Caledonia

Partners from across Melanesia and beyond spent a week together in Nouméa, New Caledonia (15–19 April 2024), to co-design and launch the MELANOBS network.
:::
:::
